our_title: Distributed graph loaders accept negative vertex/edge counts: huge allocation and multi-process hang
ran: mpirun --oversubscribe -np 1 bin_pristine/dgload negvert.grf (header '-4 8'): 'AddressSanitizer: allocation-size-too-big'; -np 2 negvert.grf: one rank aborts, the other HANGS (timeout). Same for negedge.grf ('4 -8'). PATCHED (bin_build, patch 0001/0002): rc=1 on all ranks, no alloc, no hang.
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/dgraph_io_load.c dgraphLoadCent header block (reduglbtab[1]/[2]) and dgraphLoadDist header block (reduloctab[3]/[5]/[10]/[11])
evidence: The header checks validated only the property field (0..111); a negative vertglbnbr/edgeglbnbr (or vertlocnbr/edgelocnbr) flowed into memAlloc((vertglbmax + 2 + ...) * sizeof(Gnum)) producing a near-SIZE_MAX request, and on np>=2 the aborting rank left its peers blocked in the following MPI collective. graphLoad rejects these ('invalid number of vertices/edges'); the distributed loaders did not.

fix_options.label: Reject negative counts in both loaders
fix_options.summary: Add vertglbnbr/edgeglbnbr (and local-count) negativity checks to the header validation of dgraphLoadCent and dgraphLoadDist.
fix_options.tested: 32/64-bit: negvert/negedge rc=1 on all ranks, no ASan/hang; valid files unaffected.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Same rejection graphLoad already performs for the centralized format.

our_title: dgraphSave allocation failure is local-only; peers hang in the label halo exchange
ran: timeout 12 mpirun -np 2 -x LD_PRELOAD=fishim.so -x FI_RANK=1 -x FI_NTH=3 bin_pristinefi/halofi lblring.grf : rank1 'dgraphSave: out of memory' then rank0 HANGS (it proceeds into dgraphHaloSync/MPI_Alltoallv). exit 124.
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/dgraph_io_save.c:~72 (dgraphGhst) and :~75 (vlblgsttax memAlloc), both return 1 locally before dgraphHaloSync
evidence: For a labeled or holey graph, dgraphSave allocates vlblgsttax and calls dgraphHaloSync (collective). If the allocation fails on one rank, that rank returns 1 before the halo exchange while peers enter it and block. Same collective-safety class as PS-DGR-2.

fix_options.label: Agree on the allocation status before the halo exchange
fix_options.summary: Reduce the local allocation flag across the communicator in dgraphSave before calling dgraphHaloSync, returning on every rank if any failed.
fix_options.tested: untested: part of the same halo collective-safety decision as PS-DGR-2 (alt A/B); not committed.
fix_options.tradeoffs: One small collective in the save path (not a hot loop, so cheaper than the halo-core case).
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Matches his 7.0.17 reworks that make a local allocation failure join the following collective (e.g. dgraphInduce2, hdgraphGather).
